description: A shell script for testing and calculating git patch IDs, including setup, comparison, and various test cases for patch ID consistency and behavior.

methods.name: calc_patch_id
methods.description: Calculates the patch ID for a given diff or log output, ensuring the output is a single line.

methods.name: get_top_diff
methods.description: Retrieves the top diff of the latest commit with specific options.

methods.name: get_patch_id
methods.description: Gets the patch ID for a specific commit or diff.

methods.name: cmp_patch_id
methods.description: Compares two patch IDs based on relevance.
